title: Balanced Brackets
statement: A code editor wants to warn students about unmatched brackets. Given a string made of the characters ( ) [ ] { }, decide whether every opening bracket is closed by the matching bracket in the right order.
input_format: One line containing the bracket string (it may be empty).
output_format: Print YES if the brackets are balanced, otherwise NO.

examples.explanation: Every bracket is closed in the right order, so the answer is YES.

hints: The most recently opened bracket must be the first one to close.
A stack fits this: push opening brackets, and on a closing bracket check the top.
At the end the stack must be empty; a closing bracket with an empty stack is also a failure.
